audit_note: 28 audited findings. Reviewer verdicts: ChatGPT MAJOR, Grok MINOR, Gemini MAJOR. Post-audit: Grok's MINOR better calibrated. VERIFIED 12, PARTIAL 4, OPINION 5, STALE 1, FALSIFIED 4, HOUSTON-DECISION 2. ChatGPT BLOCKERs F3/F6 FALSIFIED. Key genuine gaps: DESIVAST program-split table (F9), Cramér's V + log10(p) (F8), logistic regression for program control (F25), analysis-tree table (F7), headline language dual-use (C1). Void-bin smallness typo (F16) was logic error missed by all internal rounds.
